items.title: Workflow skeleton (Node)
items.body:
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
items.description: Run lint and tests on push and pull request.

items.title: Workflow skeleton (Python)
items.body:
name: CI
on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: pytest -q
items.description: Set up Python with pip caching.

items.title: Matrix build
items.body:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node: [20, 22]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - run: npm ci && npm test
items.description: Run a job across several versions.

items.title: Cache dependencies manually
items.body:
- uses: actions/cache@v4
  with:
    path: ~/.cache/pip
    key: pip-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('requirements.txt') }}
    restore-keys: pip-${{ runner.os }}-

items.title: Use secrets and environment variables
items.body:
steps:
  - run: ./deploy.sh
    env:
      API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.API_TOKEN }}
      STAGE: production
items.description: Secrets are never printed; pass them via env.

items.title: Run only on tags or the main branch
items.body:
if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
# other examples:
# if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
# if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
# if: failure()

items.title: Trigger on tags, schedule and manual run
items.body:
on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * 1"      # Mondays 03:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: Where to deploy
        default: staging
items.description: Different ways to start a workflow.

items.title: Job dependencies and permissions
items.body:
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps: [{ run: echo build }]
  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps: [{ run: echo deploy }]
items.description: Run jobs in order and limit the token.

items.title: Upload and download artifacts
items.body:
- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
  with:
    name: dist
    path: dist/

# in a later job:
- uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
  with:
    name: dist
items.description: Share build output between jobs or keep it.

items.title: Release: upload a file to a GitHub Release
items.body:
permissions:
  contents: write
steps:
  - uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
    with:
      files: dist/app.zip
      generate_release_notes: true
items.description: On a v* tag, attach a build output.

items.title: Set outputs and environment between steps
items.body:
- id: version
  run: echo "value=1.2.3" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
- run: echo "Version is ${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}"
- run: echo "BUILD_ID=42" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"     # available in later steps

items.title: Build and push a Docker image
items.body:
- uses: docker/login-action@v3
  with:
    registry: ghcr.io
    username: ${{ github.actor }}
    password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
- uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
  with:
    push: true
    tags: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}:latest
items.description: Log in to GHCR and push with Buildx.

items.title: Useful contexts
items.body:
${{ github.sha }}            commit SHA
${{ github.ref_name }}       branch or tag name
${{ github.repository }}     owner/repo
${{ github.actor }}          user who triggered the run
${{ runner.os }}             Linux, Windows or macOS
${{ secrets.NAME }}          a repository secret
items.description: Values you can read in expressions.

items.title: CI/CD pipeline stages
items.body:
1. Lint + format check      2. Type check       3. Unit tests
4. Build                    5. Integration/e2e tests
6. Publish artifact/image   7. Deploy to staging + smoke test
8. Manual approval          9. Deploy to production + monitor/rollback
items.description: A typical order of stages and gates.
